title: Store Update 1.30.0
body:
# Store Update 1.30.0

Raiders!

Today brings a small store update: two new colour variants for the Leviathan Set are now available, Midnight and Crimson Frost. Anyone who already owns the Leviathan Set will have these unlocked without any extra action. There is no need to restart the game.

Following a review of data and the initial feedback since Ermal showed up in Speranza, we are changing the Expedition Vault pricing this week to encourage more trading. The cost of tier one stays the same, and every tier after that now costs 200.000.

* T1: 200.000 → 200.000

* T2: 400.000 → 200.000

* T3: 600.000 → 200.000

* T4: 800.000 → 200.000

* T5: 1.000.000 → 200.000

Starting today at 6am PDT, 1pm UTC, 3pm CEST, Ermal will bring a fresh round of exciting offers this week.

We will keep tracking data and feedback for the following week.

We are also aware that Xbox players have experienced crashes, and PC players have run into FPS problems, since 1.29.0. We are actively looking into these issues and working on fixes. We'll share updates as we have them, and thank you for reporting these problems.

**A note on live updates:** As explained in our blog post about changes to how ARC Raiders gets updated, live updates will now function a bit differently than before.

Our plan is to release a live update every three weeks. The size and scope of these updates will differ, but each one will give us a chance to respond to your feedback. Between these live updates, we will still push updates and hotfixes as needed, along with weekly rotations for the store and Trials. We believe this approach will give us the time and focus needed to make changes that matter to the community.

See you Topside, //Ossen
